tools.why: Carries every provider's HTTP request and the streamed response (`lib.nvim.net.curl` shells out to it); without it no provider can answer and `:Ai` has nothing to talk to. Usually already present.

Enables the ollama provider: local models, nothing leaves the machine. The binary alone is not enough -- the daemon has to be running (default http://127.0.0.1:11434, override with AI_OLLAMA_HOST). The claude, openai and gemini providers need only an API key and curl.
